claims.assertion: Swaruu (9) says Akhenaten's Egyptian followers dispersed to Sinai, Italy, Spain, Ireland, and Scotland; a later expedition founded Celtic culture.
claims.speaker: Swaruu (9)

claims.assertion: Swaruu (9) identifies herself as Meritaten, saying she joined an Egypt-to-Scotland expedition and lived that life twice.
claims.speaker: Swaruu (9)
claims.qualifiers: She says her second incarnation anticipated her assassination.

claims.assertion: Swaruu (9) describes the Cabal as a multi-species group seeking control of Earth and expansion.
claims.speaker: Swaruu (9)
claims.qualifiers: She distinguishes it from any single species.

claims.assertion: Swaruu (9) says morality depends on individuals, not species; she cites positive Draconians and negative Taygetans.
claims.speaker: Swaruu (9)

review_flags: The speaker's historical and reincarnation accounts are her claims, not independently corroborated.
coverage_gaps: claims about Druidic records, Vatican archives, and the alleged Egyptian conflict
